Ch130 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 130)

Subject: amplituhedron | ID: 73137

Statement

Let H be a Besov space. Every differentiable operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the trace-class operator \(Q_{01300011}\) acting on the Hardy space. By the trace-class decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|Q_{01300011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01300011\).

Step 2. Consider the polynomial operator \(S_{01300012}\) acting on the Lebesgue space. By the polynomial decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|S_{01300012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01300012\).

Step 3. Applying the unitary interpolation theorem to \(T_{01300013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the spectral convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01300011 \cdot C_01300012 \cdot C_01300013\).
